Pehchaan Ek Safar · IIT Ropar

Helping more children find their way into education.

Visit Pehchaan Ek Safar at IIT Ropar ↗

I helped found Pehchaan Ek Safar with friends at IIT Ropar to support children in underserved communities. Registered as an NGO in 2019, the initiative has grown into a collective effort that has reached more than 800 students through education and outreach.

Founding member · Secretary & Social Media / External Affairs Lead, 2018–2019

A growing collective effort

Pehchaan’s reach today

800+students reached through education and outreach
20+schools reached
500+volunteers over the initiative’s journey

Organization-wide figures reported on Pehchaan Ek Safar’s official website, accessed 24 October 2026. They reflect the work of successive teams and volunteers, beyond my 2018–2019 leadership role.

Why I became involved

Education opened a door for me.

Being the first in my family to pursue higher education shaped what this work meant to me. At IIT Ropar, friends and I helped build an initiative that connected the campus community with children who did not have the same access to educational support.

As a founding member, secretary, and social media and external affairs lead, I contributed to those early efforts. What makes me proud is seeing the initiative continue through new generations of students, faculty mentors, and volunteers.

Paathshala

Steady support for school.

Free tuition, help with school admissions, learning materials, and transport support address practical barriers that can keep children out of education.

Explore Paathshala ↗
Outreach

Making science accessible.

Hands-on STEM workshops, career guidance, and teacher training extend the initiative’s work into schools. Activities give children opportunities to experiment and ask their own questions.

Explore the outreach programs ↗

A shared commitment that continues.

I know how much a chance to learn can change someone’s path. Pehchaan connected that experience with something we could build together. Its continuing work is a reminder of what a committed community can make possible.
